title: Article I. On the Species of Contemplation according to the Divine Dionysius

blocks.s: That a worthy beginning be made, we must first speak of contemplation according to the most divine of theologians and prince of contemplatives, the sacred and most ardent lover of the Divinity, Dionysius.

In the fourth chapter of On the Divine Names, Dionysius sets forth three species of contemplation, which he names after kinds of local motion, affirming that they belong differently to angels than to souls still on pilgrimage.
